name: Suspicious Mshta.EXE Execution Patterns
description: Detects suspicious mshta process execution patterns
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:*\\mshta.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:MSHTA.EXE) AND ((process.parent.executable:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) AND (process.command_line:(*\\AppData\\Local\\* OR *C\:\\ProgramData\\* OR *C\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\*)))) OR ((process.executable:*\\mshta.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:MSHTA.EXE) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)) OR (process.command_line:(*.htm* OR *.hta*)) OR (process.command_line:(*mshta.exe OR *mshta)))))
